title: Voluntary Surrender Schedule for Deficiency Balance Account Restart Down Payments
content:
**Schedule.** The restart percent of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts (the percentage of the balance at which its restart down payment is figured) is read against the Repossession and Collateral Recovery case that produced the account. When that case's recovery method is a voluntary surrender and the case records that a key was obtained, the restart percent is lowered by 2.0 points; when its recovery method is a voluntary surrender and the case records that no key was obtained, it is lowered by 1.0 point; otherwise (an involuntary recovery or an impound release) the surrender lowers the restart percent by no points.

## Schedule table

| Recovery method on the recovery case | Key obtained | Restart percent lowered by |
|---|---|---|
| Voluntary surrender | Yes | 2.0 points |
| Voluntary surrender | No | 1.0 point |
| Involuntary recovery | Yes or no | No points |
| Impound release | Yes or no | No points |

## Reading the recovery case

- The case read is the one recorded on the Deficiency Balance Account as the recovery case whose sale produced the deficiency; any other recovery case of the borrower or of another contract is not read.
- The recovery method states how the vehicle came into the company's possession; the key field states whether a key came in with the vehicle.
- Hypothetically, a borrower who surrendered the vehicle and handed in the key has the restart percent lowered by 2.0 points; one who surrendered it without the key, by 1.0 point; a vehicle taken by a recovery agency lowers it by nothing, key or no key.
